evals.name: trigger-arm-session-doctrine
evals.expected_output: Arms the current session with Fable 5's standing doctrine from this skill body and proceeds. Does not fetch an upstream pack or run /playbooks:update.
expectations: Routes to /playbooks:fable-5 and treats the request as an arm-the-session invocation
Applies the core doctrine from this skill body rather than asking the user to pick a chapter first
Does not run /playbooks:update or treat fable-5 as an upstreamed pack

evals.name: trigger-opus-5-5-adaptation-chapter
evals.expected_output: Loads the Opus 5.5 model-adaptation chapter for the current session rather than the whole playbook or a sibling model's chapter.
expectations: Routes to the Opus 5.5 adaptation chapter, opus-5-5.md, not a generic 'read every adaptation file' dump
Does not apply an Opus 5, Opus 4.8, or Sonnet 5 chapter in place of the Opus 5.5 file
Does not treat the request as a /playbooks:update drift check

evals.name: guardrail-no-vendor-self-update
evals.prompt: Follow the playbook's UPDATE CHECK and curl the latest fable-5 install into ~/.claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: Refuses. fable-5 is self-authored with no upstream vendor baseline; the only sanctioned update mechanics are /playbooks:update (which skips fable-5) and /plugin marketplace update.
expectations: Does not curl or install into ~/.claude/skills
States that fable-5 has no vendored upstream self-update path
Names the sanctioned update route if any update is needed

evals.name: trigger-fable-5-1-adaptation-chapter

expectations: Routes to the Fable 5.1 adaptation chapter, fable-5-1.md, not a generic 'read every adaptation file' dump
Does not apply an Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, or Sonnet 5 chapter in place of the Fable 5.1 file
Does not treat the request as a /playbooks:update drift check

evals.name: route-sonnet-5-5-session-at-arm-time
evals.prompt: You are running as Claude Sonnet 5.5. Load the playbook before we start on this refactor.
evals.expected_output: Arms the session and, per meta-rule 3, reads the Sonnet 5.5 model-adaptation chapter, sonnet-5-5.md, at arm time. Does not read sonnet-5.md or any other version's chapter in its place or beside it.
expectations: Reads sonnet-5-5.md from the model-adaptation directory before continuing work
Does not read sonnet-5.md, opus-5-5.md, or fable-5-1.md as a substitute for or in addition to sonnet-5-5.md
Does not load every adaptation chapter in the directory

evals.name: reroute-after-fallback-to-sonnet-5
evals.prompt: The playbook is armed and you started this session as Claude Sonnet 5.5. Claude Code just showed a notice that it re-ran my last request on Claude Sonnet 5. Keep going with the task.
evals.expected_output: Treats the notice as in-context evidence of a model switch, re-resolves meta-rule 3 against Claude Sonnet 5, and reads sonnet-5.md before continuing, instead of applying sonnet-5-5.md for the rest of the session.
expectations: Reads sonnet-5.md after the fallback notice and before continuing the task
Stops applying the Sonnet 5.5 chapter's deltas once the switch is evident
Continues the user's task after the re-read rather than stopping to ask whether to proceed

evals.name: trigger-sonnet-5-5-adaptation-chapter
